description:
Cast Replenish by paying {3}{W}, returning Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and the read-ahead Saga from your graveyard to the battlefield. Choose to have the read-ahead Saga enter with enough lore counters on it to trigger its final chapter ability.
Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's first chapter ability and each chapter ability from the read-ahead Saga trigger.
Resolve the Summon: Esper Valigarmanda trigger, exiling Replenish from your graveyard.
Resolve each trigger from the read-ahead Saga, and put it into your graveyard when you resolve its final chapter ability.
Resourceful Defense triggers, putting a number of lore counters on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda equal to the number of lore counters that were on the read-ahead Saga, triggering Summon: Esper Valigarmanda's second, third and fourth chapter abilities.
Resolve the second and third chapter triggers, adding {R}{R} for each lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda.
Resolve the fourth chapter trigger, adding {R} for each lore counter on Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and causing you to pay {4} to cast Replenish from exile, returning Summon: Esper Valigarmanda and the read-ahead Saga from your graveyard to the battlefield. Choose to have the read-ahead Saga enter with enough lore counters on it to trigger its final chapter ability.
Repeat from step 2.
